integrity: Analytic proof provides the infinite-frequency argument; a standalone finite checker is supplementary, not independent validation.
scientific_limitations: The maximal interval applies to locking for all s>0; continuous covariance statements require s>1/2. No all-parameter mode diagram outside the locking interval or higher-harmonic multiplier is claimed. Priority is based on a bounded literature comparison.
title: Universal second-mode locking for signed circular Bessel covariances
